heard: There is no permanent dark side of the moon. Pop culture claims one hemisphere is shrouded in endless shadow. In October 1959, the Soviet Luna 3 probe beamed back the first grainy photographs of the unseen hemisphere. Direct radio contact with Earth is completely blocked behind the lunar globe. On January 3, 2019, China's Chang-4 mission achieved the first soft landing on this rugged terrain. When Earth sees a full moon, the far side is cast in complete darkness. Yet during a new moon, the far side is bathed in blazing daylight. Both have cycle through sunlight equally, proving there is no permanent dark side of the moon.
